configurePresets.name: no-vcpkg-base
configurePresets.description: Identical to 'base' except it sets no toolchainFile, so configure relies purely on find_package() resolving each dependency (hwy, tomlplusplus, spdlog, Catch2, benchmark) against system-installed CMake config packages. CLAUDE.md portability contract: 'The build must not hard-require vcpkg... a contributor who cannot bootstrap vcpkg must still be able to build and run the tests.'

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Debug build with full diagnostics and -Werror. Default day-to-day preset.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build for distribution. No -march=native, portable across the CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD target ISA baseline; hot kernels dispatch at runtime via Highway.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Debug build instrumented with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. GCC/Clang only.

configurePresets.name: bench
configurePresets.description: Release build with -march=native scoped to the benchmarks/ target only, for the sharpest possible local performance numbers. NEVER used for a wheel, release binary, or CI artifact — see CLAUDE.md #2.3.

configurePresets.name: system
configurePresets.description: Same as 'dev' but configured against system-installed dependencies instead of vcpkg (e.g. `apt install libhwy-dev catch2 libspdlog-dev libtomlplusplus-dev libbenchmark-dev`) — no VCPKG_ROOT needed. Python bindings off (nanobind isn't assumed to be a system package); everything needed to build and run the test suite is on. See scripts/README or CI job 'system-packages' for the exact apt package list this was verified against (Ubuntu 24.04).
